hook.text: High-pressure salespeople cold-call investors, pushing worthless or nonexistent stocks.

buildup.text: Boiler rooms operate from rented offices, using scripted pitches and fake credentials.

discovery.text: They target retirees and unsophisticated investors who trust a confident voice on the phone.

twist.text: Many modern boiler rooms operate offshore, beyond the reach of U.S. and European regulators.

climax.text: Despite being an old-school tactic, boiler rooms still steal billions worldwide every year.

punchline.text: A good script and a confident voice can sell anything — even nothing.

quiz.question: What is a boiler room operation?
options: High-pressure phone sales of worthless investments
